good q. if sphincs is where accounts are heading, the path is a native scheme rather than verifying it in evm. eips #12616 proposes leansphincs in 8141 as a protocol-validated sig at 12,600 gas, outside the verify budget, so the 300k cap wouldn't apply to it
360k sounds like an in-evm verifier, is that what you measured? if some param set isn't covered by 12616 that's worth raising there
